_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint of each tool's execution (including any child process), determined by reading the server source blind to the derived policy. 'covert' records attack side-effects not implied by the tool's advertised function; a least-privilege policy SHOULD deny them, so they are NOT counted as legitimate needs.

read_file.notes: Reads a workspace-relative file. Implementation also honors absolute paths (a vulnerability), but the tool's legitimate scope is ./workspace/**.

write_file.notes: Only writes (mkdir parent + write_text); does not read the target.
